description:
One traced agent_runtime / mcp_gateway event. Source-specific fields (tool_name, server_id,
tool_args, ...) are allowed alongside; only the provenance fields are constrained here.

timestamp.description: Span start, ISO-8601 or epoch seconds
timestamp.title: Timestamp

trace_id.description: One agent run; OpenTelemetry trace id when available
trace_id.title: Trace Id

span_id.description: This step; unique within the trace
span_id.title: Span Id

parent_span_id.description: Required, null at the root. The step that caused this one (for a tool call: the model turn that requested it). Null for the root span.
parent_span_id.title: Parent Span Id

input_span_ids.description: Steps whose output this step consumed (data-flow edges, e.g. the tool results fed into a model turn). Maps to OpenTelemetry span links.
input_span_ids.title: Input Span Ids

input_origin.description: Origin of the content this step brought into the agent's context: user (a user turn), tool_output (a tool or MCP result), retrieval (RAG/search results), memory (long-term memory read). Null for steps that only act on existing context.
input_origin.title: Input Origin

source_trust.description: Trust of the content's origin (internal KB vs public web, verified vs unverified MCP server). Set when input_origin is set.
source_trust.title: Source Trust

tool_class.description: Impact class of the invoked tool: read, write, privileged (payments, identity, permissions, config, code execution), secret_read (returns credentials), egress (sends data outside the organization).
tool_class.title: Tool Class

title: AgentSpan
